published_ms.description: Total elapsed time in milliseconds across all quest publication intervals at response time. Each interval ends at the earliest of its scheduled end, actual closure, or server time. Excludes gaps and unused prepaid time; includes time hidden by moderation while the publication remains running. Null when historical intervals are missing or incomplete. Optional for compatibility with older servers.

cover_original.description: Public uncropped quest cover URL or legacy PocketBase file path for the image viewer. Falls back to the existing display, full legacy file, or space cover when no uncropped variant exists. Optional for older servers; empty if no image exists. The cover field retains its cropped card/detail presentation.

screenshot_count.description: Exact required screenshot count for Screenshot or Action verification=screenshot. Completion must contain exactly this many media IDs. Earlier Action publications without this field retain the 1–5 image range.

verification.description: Screenshots, a participant result URL, or a community check by username. url and community require content_version=4 and use instructions in the quest description, without a separate author target URL. platform retains the legacy shared/individual protocol. Unscoped confirmation requires content_version=5: participants confirm completion without a URL, screenshots, external platform, or username. Moderators verify the action using the author guide; existing publications retain their evidence requirements. Scoped confirmation requires content_version=6 and uses the published platform plus platform_account; moderators receive the external username and service favicon.

platform_domain.description: Canonical external platform domain, normalized by the server. Presence opts Action into content_version=3; empty means screenshots without an external platform. Shared derives it from the published target URL; individual requires an author-selected domain. With v4, community requires an author-selected domain; url may leave it empty to accept any nonblocked HTTP(S) site without an identity claim, or set it to restrict result links and scope usernames. Restrictions apply to canonical hosts and known aliases, not URL paths. With content_version=6, confirmation may also select a nonempty service domain and atomically claim its username. An empty domain retains the v5 confirmation protocol without an identity claim. The current author form selects one common service for screenshot, url, and confirmation.

QuestPublicConfig.description: Identity version 2 requires content_version >= 10. submitter is available only for screenshot/url. Existing unversioned identity rules remain unchanged.

requires_rating.description: True until the selected player records the assignment's single immutable rating vote.

QuestAttemptState.description: The authenticated viewer's next attempt against the selected immutable publication. Counts reset on a new publication; successful stable-quest completion remains terminal. A next value of 0 means no attempt is currently available.

publication_id.description: Immutable publication used for this card's content and attempt state; empty for Welcome or legacy quests without a publication.

submission_count.description: All saved submissions for this quest across every publication and status, including repeat attempts. Counts sends, not unique participants or accepted completions. Optional for compatibility with older servers.

cover_original.description: Public uncropped quest cover URL or legacy PocketBase file path for the image viewer. Falls back to the existing display, full legacy file, or space cover when no uncropped variant exists. Optional for older servers; empty if no image exists. The cover field retains its cropped card/detail presentation.

moderation_status.description: Optional public identity status; restricted profiles use masked name and avatar. Older responses and missing-user fallbacks may omit it.

platform.description: Canonical identity domain; independent from the host trust decision.

account.description: Platform username supplied by the participant, not verified account ownership. Available for platform and screenshot evidence; empty when omitted or hidden during the instructions phase.

participant.description: Questfall name captured when the completion was submitted. Show alongside account to identify the participant and the external username to check; hidden during the instructions phase.

verification.description: Completion evidence method. url and community require content_version=4; both use kind=platform or the initial quest review. url needs a result URL without requiring an account for unrestricted sites; community needs the published platform and username, with navigation in the quest description. Unscoped confirmation requires content_version=5: participants confirm completion without a URL, screenshots, external platform, or username. Moderators verify the action using the author guide; existing publications retain their evidence requirements. Scoped confirmation requires content_version=6 and uses the published platform plus platform_account; moderators receive the external username and service favicon.

identity.description: Identity and custom requirements from the immutable submitted publication, never the current editable draft. Null for earlier publications.

rating_vote.description: The assignment's immutable vote, including when this particular quest attempt was rejected; null for ordinary completions.

QuestResolutionNotice.description: A completion resolution notification. In explicit acknowledgement mode, id is an opaque receipt tied to this exact resolution, not a quest or submission identifier to parse on the client.

PlatformAccounts.description: Recent identities owned by this user in the closed platform identity registry, grouped by canonical domain. Known aliases share one list; the old user-side cache cannot establish selectable ownership.

mining_rewards.description: Optional current rewards summary included by /auth/me. Omitted if the independent rewards projection is unavailable.

original.description: Optional quest_cover_v2 variant preserving the complete image and aspect ratio, no upscaling, at most 3000 × 3000 pixels and 4 MiB. Metadata is stripped during WebP encoding. Older uploads can omit it.

QuestContentDocument.description: Immutable versioned instructions. Image attrs contain media_id and caption, never signed URLs or binary data. Media are resolved separately with authorization.

QuestAuthorConfig.description: Identity version 2 requires content_version >= 10. submitter is available only for screenshot/url. Existing unversioned identity rules remain unchanged.

QuestEvidence.description: Action verification=screenshot requires exactly screenshot_count media IDs (1–5); earlier publications without screenshot_count accept 1–5 media IDs. It requires no link. Action verification=platform accepts no media IDs; proof_url is required only for link_mode=individual, while shared uses the author’s published target link. Unified Action requires content_version=2. With config.platform_domain present, content_version=3 is required: a nonempty domain fixes identity scope from the publication, including screenshots, and an omitted or blank platform_account uses the current Questfall name. The first successful submission atomically claims the normalized identity; another owner is rejected without spending resources. Shared and individual URLs must match that canonical platform, including known aliases. Empty platform_domain keeps screenshots unscoped. Before v3, screenshot platform_account is optional participant-provided evidence without an identity claim, while platform verification requires an explicit account. Legacy Screenshot keeps its exact screenshot_count and optional platform_account; legacy Action keeps 1–4 screenshots plus URL and account. A supplied account is trimmed and limited to 128 characters. content_version=4 also supports verification=url (one result URL, no screenshots, optional author domain restriction) and community (no evidence URL or images; instructions are in the description and the published platform scopes the username). Unrestricted url submissions do not infer or claim a platform identity from the submitted URL. Both use direct platform judging without a witness stage. Existing publications keep their earlier protocol. With content_version=5, verification=confirmation accepts no screenshots and ignores supplied URLs, platform names and usernames. It creates a direct moderation review, without claiming an external identity. The v5 author form offered screenshot (exactly one), unrestricted url, or confirmation, with no platform settings; prior screenshot counts and platform-scoped publications remain supported. With content_version=6 and a nonempty published platform_domain, confirmation accepts platform_account (blank defaults to the Questfall name), atomically claims that service identity, and exposes it to moderators. Supplied URLs remain ignored and screenshots rejected. The service can never be overridden by completion input. Username uniqueness is per canonical service; the same username may belong to different users on different services. Existing v5 unscoped confirmations keep their original behavior. With content_version>=7, platform_account must be explicitly provided and nonblank after trimming whenever the published configuration uses a service identity. Legacy Action/Screenshot forms that display a username also require it. The server rejects missing or whitespace-only usernames before identity claims, submissions, or resource charges; it never substitutes the Questfall name for these requests. Explicitly unscoped publications keep their prior protocol without a username requirement. Earlier clients retain the previous fallback behavior, and already accepted requests still replay idempotently. Content v10 identity.version=2: omit platform_account for submitter and account + questfall.xyz; the server uses the authenticated participant and creates no external account binding. Other account/wallet settings require an explicit platform_account. Each individual result URL (trimmed exact URL) may be submitted only once per quest across users, statuses and publications, even after rejection. The same idempotency-key replay still returns its original receipt. Screenshot variants are prepared by the client with the account watermark before media upload; historical evidence is unchanged.

section.description: Author workspace organization, independent of publication and moderation state. Drafts have never been published; Archive is explicitly chosen by the team.

archived_at.description: Manual archive time in Unix milliseconds, or zero.

edited_at.description: Unix milliseconds of the latest normalized material edit after the last publication began, for inactive quests. Zero when none is recorded; older records are not inferred from updated. Cover, Bounty, duration, tags and service changes do not count.

retired.description: Retired legacy Action/Screenshot record. Content editing, activation, reactivation, extension and duplication are unavailable; history and existing moderation remain accessible. Replacement must be created as a new Action quest.

publication_id.description: Related publication. Closing events (including author unpublication, expiry and moderation) expose this ID for viewing their results. Publication-start events retain it for older clients.

rating_vote.description: The assignment's immutable vote, including when this particular quest attempt was rejected; null for ordinary completions.

feedback_unread.description: Unread quest feedback across this space for the authenticated team member. Omitted by older servers.

QuestIdentity.description: Published identification method. Missing version retains content v9: account/wallet require an explicit platform_account scoped to platform_domain; questfall requires the authenticated Questfall name in the original result and retains custom instructions. Version 2 requires content_version >= 10: account + questfall.xyz uses the authenticated participant automatically, without an external binding or trusting platform_account. Other account/wallet services still require platform_account. submitter requires version 2 and permits screenshot/url only, clears platform_domain and ignores platform_account; no source account is required in the result. Version 2 screenshot evidence is watermarked by the client with the submitted source username/wallet or the authenticated Questfall name for automatic identity. Moderators compare this label against the saved submission identity; it is not a server signature or authorship proof. The identity and instructions are preserved in publication and moderation snapshots. Preview state is never persisted.

version.description: Explicit content v10 policy. Missing version keeps the original v9 behavior, including external claims on questfall.xyz.
